equity.level_reason: Rates by race/ethnicity, age, sex, rurality and county SES (housing problems, income inequality, unemployment) are reported and framed as an 'unequal distribution', but between-group contrasts are only side by side; the computed RRs are period contrasts within groups, so the cap at 2 applies.

level_alternative.reason: Area SES determinants are the analyzed stratifiers and named as causes; reading the cross-group comparison of RRs (largest increases in highest quartiles) as quantified would give level 3, and the determinants would lift it to 4.

notes: Design inferred (not named): surveillance of EMS records with year-vs-2019 trend. The 'rate' is firearm encounters per 100,000 total EMS encounters, a unitless proportion, so binary/categorical; count/rate is the alternative reading. Quartile cutpoints, collapsing to 'Other' and the ≥75% coverage inclusion rule are quantization or exclusion, not procedures.
view_issues: Table lowest unemployment quartile is labelled '5.1' (presumably ≤5.1). Group differences are only side by side; RRs contrast years within each group.
